recentActivity.summary: DataOps backfilled raw_meta_ads_campaigns to 2024-04-01. Rebuilt Meta Funnel YoY dashboard with full 3-year window. Justin's TOF-duration-frequency hypothesis is now fully vindicated by clean data: April TOF avg daily spend 2024/$700, 2025/$1,137, 2026/$457; frequency 1.31, 1.77, 1.42; ROAS 0.87, 1.67, 0.56. 2025 was a TOF peak year (1,205 purchases vs 578 in 2024 and 249 in 2026). 2026 dropped TOF intensity and shifted toward Retargeting (442 purchases, ROAS 5.94 — Retargeting is healthy). Justin caught a data gap in the Meta Funnel YoY dashboard — raw_meta_ads_campaigns table starts 2025-04-14, missing Apr 1-13, which made April 2025 TOF look like '17 active days at $1,190/day' when account-level data shows we actually spent every day in early April 2025 at $800-$1,500/day. Page updated with red warning banner + PARTIAL flags on all April 2025 rows. DataOps inbox task filed to extend backfill to at least 2025-01-01 (ideally 2024-04-01 for full 2-yr YoY window). April 2026 ran TOF diluted (30 days, $457/day, freq 1.42, 249 purchases, ROAS 0.56). Tested Justin's frequency-vs-budget theory across 13 months of Meta data. Effective frequency exists (Freq↔ROAS r=+0.25) but the budget→frequency causal chain is REVERSED (Spend↔Freq r=−0.46).
